title: The board and the pieces
summary: How every piece moves and captures.

steps.text:
Chess is played on an 8x8 board. Files are the columns a-h, ranks the rows 1-8. White always moves first.

The **king** moves one square in any direction. The **queen** moves any distance in a straight line or diagonal. The **rook** moves in straight lines, the **bishop** on diagonals, and the **knight** jumps in an L-shape (two squares one way, one square sideways) - it is the only piece that can jump over others. **Pawns** move forward one square (two on their first move) and capture diagonally.

steps.prompt: Use the knight's L-shaped jump to capture the black rook.
steps.hint: Count two squares up and one to the left from e3.
steps.success: The knight jumps straight to d5 and takes the rook.

steps.prompt: A pawn that reaches the last rank becomes any piece. Promote this pawn to a queen.
steps.hint: Push the pawn one more square.
steps.success: Promotion! You now have a queen.
